menu:41716240:1.text: Why is the ground around here so uneven?!
menu:41716240:1.source_cn: 这里的地面，怎么这么不平整！

say:2:1062802002:1.text: Ah... Sorry you had to see me in such a disheveled state.
say:2:1062802002:1.source_cn: 哈、哈哈……真是不好意思，让你看见我这么狼狈的样子……
say:2:1062802002:1.male: Ah... Sorry you had to see me in such a disheveled state.
say:2:1062802002:1.female: Ah... Sorry you had to see me in such a disheveled state.

say:4:1062802003:1.source_cn: 哈哈……不小心摔了一跤而已……
say:4:1062802003:1.male: I just took a little tumble, it's no big deal.
say:4:1062802003:1.female: I just took a little tumble, it's no big deal.

say:5:1062802004:1.text: The ground here is so bumpy, and I wasn't paying attention, so...
say:5:1062802004:1.source_cn: 这里的地面凹凸不平的，大概是遗迹被土盖住了吧。我没注意...
say:5:1062802004:1.male: The ground here is so bumpy, and I wasn't paying attention, so...

say:6:1062802005:1.text: But more importantly, all my stuff, every last bit of it...
say:6:1062802005:1.source_cn: 不过，比起这个更重要的是，我的商品全都……全都……
say:6:1062802005:1.male: But more importantly, all my stuff, every last bit of it...
say:6:1062802005:1.female: But more importantly, all my stuff, every last bit of it...

say:8:1062802007:1.text: Magister, since I took a bad fall, could you lend me a hand once more?
say:8:1062802007:1.source_cn: 魔法师大人，看在我狠狠摔了一大跤的份上，就再帮我一次吧！

choice:3:1:2.text: Why are you on the ground?
choice:3:1:2.male: Why are you on the ground?
choice:3:1:2.female: Why are you on the ground?

say:1:1062803001:1.text: I'm really sorry, I'm always bothering you like this...
say:1:1062803001:1.source_cn: 真是太不好意思了，每次都要麻烦魔法师大人你……

say:3:1062803002:1.text: ... So this is the Sun Temple! No wonder those statues didn't look like the goddess Dura.
say:3:1062803002:1.source_cn: ……原来这里是日神殿啊！我说那些神像看起来不像是艾雅女神呢。
say:3:1062803002:1.male: ... So this is the Sun Temple! No wonder those statues didn't look like the goddess Dura.
say:3:1062803002:1.female: ... So this is the Sun Temple! No wonder those statues didn't look like the goddess Dura.

say:4:1062803003:1.text: I was planning on heading straight back to Holistone from the Moon Temple, but it looks like I got lost again.
say:4:1062803003:1.source_cn: 我本来是打算直接从月神殿返回圣石镇的，不过……我好像又...
say:4:1062803003:1.male: I was planning on heading straight back to Holistone from the Moon Temple, but it looks like I got lost again.
say:4:1062803003:1.female: I was planning on heading straight back to Holistone from the Moon Temple, but it looks like I got lost again.

say:5:1062803004:1.text: Oh, and that legend about getting divine guidance at the Moon Temple? It's all lies! I tossed a moonstone in, and nothing happened at all.
say:5:1062803004:1.source_cn: 对了，月神殿那个能得到神启的传说好像不太灵验！我把月光...
say:5:1062803004:1.male: Oh, and that legend about getting divine guidance at the Moon Temple? It's all lies! I tossed a moonstone in, and nothing happened at all.
say:5:1062803004:1.female: Oh, and that legend about getting divine guidance at the Moon Temple? It's all lies! I tossed a moonstone in, and nothing happened at all.

say:6:1062803005:1.text: And I spent my whole year's food budget on that! What rotten luck I have...
say:6:1062803005:1.source_cn: 那可是我一年的伙食费啊，就这样打水漂了……！
say:6:1062803005:1.male: And I spent my whole year's food budget on that! What rotten luck I have...
say:6:1062803005:1.female: And I spent my whole year's food budget on that! What rotten luck I have...

say:7:1062803006:1.text: Anyways, I can't mope around. I gotta hurry back to Holistone and make some money, or I'll be eating stale bread for months!
say:7:1062803006:1.source_cn: 不行，我不能再休息了，我得赶紧回圣石镇做生意，不然真的...
